How it works

Your course, your papers, one clear plan.

Plaeta does not come loaded with someone else's notes. It learns your course from the documents you already have.

01

Add your subjects and syllabus

Upload the syllabus for each subject. Plaeta lists its topics and dot points so you can tick them off as you learn them.

02

Upload past papers

Drag in a paper with its marking guidelines or solutions. Every question is read, sorted into topics and ready to practise.

03

Answer, get marked, improve

Type or photograph your answer. You get a mark against the criteria, clear feedback, and the topics to work on next.

Marking you can check

Feedback that shows where the marks went.

Each answer is marked against the guidelines that came with the paper, criterion by criterion, so you can see what earned marks and what was missing.

  • Every question can be marked. No caps per paper.
  • Clearly labelled as AI. Check it against your criteria, and ask your teacher when unsure.
  • Mistakes become practice. Weak topics feed your flashcards and your study plan.
Modern HistoryPractice paper · Q14
Question 14 · 4 marks

Explain two causes of the economic collapse described in Source B.

Source B shows that falling crop prices left farmers unable to repay loans, which caused rural banks to fail…
Identifies two relevant causes2 / 2
Explains each with evidence from the source1 / 2
3out of 4AI-marked
To get the last mark: link your second cause to a detail in the source, such as the figures for bank closures.

Questions

Good to know.

Which courses does Plaeta work with?
Any Year 11 and 12 course with a syllabus and past papers. You upload your own syllabus, so Plaeta follows exactly what your course covers, whichever state you study in.
Does Plaeta come with past papers?
No. You upload the papers you have, from your teachers, your school or your own collection, along with their marking guidelines or solutions. Plaeta marks against those.
What counts as a paper?
One uploaded exam or practice paper counts as one paper, at the moment you upload it. Every question in it can be marked, as many times as you like.
What happens to my papers after 60 days?
The paper file and its question text are deleted automatically. Your own answers, marks, feedback, flashcards and progress stay in your account.
Can AI marking be wrong?
Yes, sometimes. Every AI mark is labelled, and it is always measured against the criteria you uploaded. Use it to practise and check it against your criteria. Your teacher's marks always come first.
Who can sign up?
Plaeta is made for students aged about 16 to 18. You enter your date of birth when you sign up. If you are under 18, a parent or carer should read the terms with you and look after payment.
Can I cancel?
Yes, in one step from Settings. You can also pause your plan for up to two months and keep everything. Before you cancel, you can download all your data.
